data.name: Faitah
data.gender_notes: Faitah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘فتاح’ (Fatah), meaning ‘opener’, ‘opening’, or ‘revelation’, Faitah is a beautiful name for a baby girl. In Islamic tradition, the name is often associated with the opening of the Quran, and the revelation of Allah’s word to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Faitah carries the meaning “Opening, Beginning, Revelation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Faitah usually hope their child will grow to embody opening, beginning, revelation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beginning of a new journey, a new revelation, or a new opening in one’s life. Encourages courage and determination to face new challenges and embrace new opportunities.
data.etymology: Faitah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Opening, Beginning, Revelation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faitah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
